source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 1 exercise solved (PDF 30-32), with the printed answer key (PDF 226) checked against the text.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur long sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Q.1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. What is the primary purpose of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)?
(Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) ka sab se bara maqsad kya hai?)

options.text: Waqt aur kharche ke andaze ke andar high-quality software dena

blocks.explanation: Chapter (1.2) kehta hai ke SDLC ka bara maqsad high-quality software dena hai jo customer ki tawaqqo poori kare aur waqt aur kharche (time and cost) ke andaze ke andar mukammal ho.

blocks.prompt:
2. Which type of requirement specifies how the system should perform?
(Kaun si requirement batati hai ke system ko kaise perform karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Non-functional requirements batati hain ke system kaam KAISE kare (performance, usability, reliability, security); functional requirements batati hain ke system KYA kare.

blocks.prompt:
3. In the context of SDLC, what is the role of a framework?
(SDLC mein framework ka kya kirdar hai?)

options.text: Pehle se bane components aur architectures ke saath structured bunyad dena

blocks.explanation: Framework concepts, practices aur tools ka reusable set hai jo predefined (pehle se bane) components aur architectures ke saath structured bunyad deta hai (1.2.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (page 223) (c) "To manage hardware" deti hai. 1.2.1 ke mutabiq framework structured bunyad deta hai, is liye sahi jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Which software development model involves working in short cycles or sprints?
(Kaun sa software development model chhote cycles ya sprints mein kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agile Methodology chhote cycles mein kaam karti hai jinhein iterations ya sprints kehte hain (1.3.1.2). Scrum Agile par bana framework hai; Waterfall seedha (linear) model hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Which role is responsible for removing obstacles and facilitating Scrum practices?
(Scrum mein rukawatein hatane aur Scrum practices aasan banane ki zimmedari kis role ki hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scrum Master process ko aasan banata hai, rukawatein (obstacles) hatata hai aur dekhta hai ke team Scrum practices follow kare (1.3.1.3).

blocks.prompt:
6. Which of the following is not a benefit of DevOps?
(In mein se kaun sa DevOps ka faida nahi?)

options.text: Project scope creep (daire ka be-qaboo phailao) mein izafa

blocks.explanation: Kitab DevOps ke faide yeh likhti hai: improved collaboration, faster time-to-market, enhanced quality aur increased efficiency. Scope creep (project ke daire ka be-qaboo phailao) masla hai, faida nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (b) "Enhanced quality" deti hai. Magar 1.3.1.4 mein Enhanced Quality DevOps ka faida likha hai; jo faida nahi woh (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. What is a crucial aspect of comprehensive project planning?
(Comprehensive project planning ka aham pehlu kya hai?)

options.text: Project ka scope aur kaam samajhna
Project ki colour scheme tay karna
Mumkina risks ko nazar andaz karna

blocks.explanation: Comprehensive planning ka matlab hai shuru karne se pehle samajhna ke kya karna hai, kaun karega aur kaise karega (1.4.1), yani scope aur tasks samajhna.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (c) "Hiring a large development team" deti hai. 1.4.1 kehta hai planning = kya, kaun aur kaise samajhna; is liye sahi jawab (a) hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Which factor does NOT influence the cost estimation of a software project?
(Kaun sa factor software project ke kharche ke andaze par asar NAHI dalta?)
blocks.explanation: Scope, technology stack aur operational costs sab cost estimation (1.4.3) mein aate hain; meetings ki tadaad kharche ka factor nahi.

blocks.prompt:
9. What is the purpose of a contingency fund in cost estimation?
(Kharche ke andaze mein contingency fund ka maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Contingency fund achanak (unforeseen) masaail ke liye rakha jata hai (1.4.3); kitab ki misal mein yeh total ka 10% hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (c) "To hire additional developers" deti hai. 1.4.3 kehta hai contingency fund achanak masaail ke liye hai; sahi jawab (a) hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. Which of the following is a purpose of Use Case Diagrams?
(In mein se Use Case Diagrams ka maqsad kaun sa hai?)

options.text: System ki functional requirements pehchanna aur likhna
System ke user interface ka design tay karna

blocks.explanation: Use Case Diagram functional requirements pehchanta aur likhta hai, users ka system se interaction dikhata hai aur planning/testing mein madad deta hai (1.5.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
1. Differentiate between functional and non-functional requirements.
Functional aur non-functional requirements mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Functional requirements batati hain ke system KYA kare; non-functional requirements batati hain ke system KITNI achhi tarah (kaise) kare.
Functional requirements: system KYA kare (us ke kaam aur functions), maslan user kitab search aur borrow kar sake.
Non-functional requirements: system KITNI achhi tarah kare (performance, usability, reliability, security), maslan ek waqt mein 1000 users sambhale.
Functional ka talluq user ke kaam se hai; non-functional ka quality aur pabandiyon (constraints) se.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain why the testing phase is important in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and provide two reasons for its significance.
Bataein ke SDLC mein testing phase kyun aham hai, aur is ki ahmiyat ki do wajahein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Testing SDLC ka woh phase hai jis mein bane hue software ko check kiya jata hai taake bugs, errors ya masaail mil saken. Yeh quality check hai ke software umeed ke mutabiq kaam kare (functionality, performance aur compatibility testing).
Testing mein bana hua software check hota hai taake users tak pohanchne se pehle bugs aur errors mil jayen.
1. Chhupe bugs mil kar theek hote hain, is liye software reliable (bharosemand) aur smooth chalta hai.
2. Software user ki zaroorat aur specifications poori karta hai (functionality, performance, compatibility).
Deployment se pehle ghalti theek karna baad ke muqable mein sasta bhi hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Illustrate the concept of continuous integration in Agile Methodology and discuss its importance in software development.
Agile Methodology mein continuous integration ka concept samjhayein aur software development mein is ki ahmiyat par baat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Continuous integration (CI) Agile ki practice hai jis mein developers apne code ki tabdeeliyan baar baar ek central repository (markazi code store) mein merge karte hain taake masaail jaldi pakre aur theek kiye ja saken.
Continuous integration (CI): developers apne code ki tabdeeliyan baar baar central repository (markazi code store) mein merge karte hain, jahan mila hua code build aur test hota hai.
Misal: Ali (login) aur Sara (payment) roz merge karte hain; Sara ki tabdeeli login tor de to usi din pata chal kar theek ho jata hai.
Ahmiyat: ghaltiyan jaldi milti hain, conflicts kam hote hain, aur chalta hua version hamesha delivery ke liye tayyar rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Identify the key components of the Scrum framework and analyze how each contributes to effective project management.
Scrum framework ke aham hisse pehchanein aur analyze karein (jaanchein) ke har hissa project management mein kaise madad karta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Scrum complex software projects ke liye Agile framework hai. Is ke teen aham hisse hain: roles, events aur artifacts.
Scrum Agile framework hai; is ke teen aham hisse hain: roles, events aur artifacts.
Roles (kirdar): Product Owner backlog ki priority tay karta hai; Scrum Master rukawatein hatata hai; Development Team increments deliver karti hai.
Events: Sprints, Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Review aur Retrospective se baqaida progress check aur feedback milta hai.
Artifacts: Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog aur Increment se kaam nazar mein aur planned rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Evaluate the main steps involved in risk assessment and management, and assess their importance in a software project.
Risk assessment aur management ke main steps ko evaluate karein (jaanchein) aur software project mein un ki ahmiyat bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Risk assessment aur management ka matlab hai project ko nuqsan dene wale risks (khatre) pehchanna, unhein parakhna aur un se nimatne ka plan banana. Main steps:
Risk management: project ko nuqsan dene wale risks (khatre) pehchanna aur sambhalna.
Steps: 1) risks identify karna (technical, operational, external); 2) un ka imkaan (likelihood) aur asar (impact) analyze karna; 3) mitigation (bachao) ka plan: buffer, backup, extra testing; 4) monitor aur review.
Ahmiyat: project waqt par, budget ke andar aur quality ke mutabiq rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain the purpose of a Use Case Diagram in software development.
Software development mein Use Case Diagram ka maqsad samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Use Case Diagram UML diagram hai jo dikhata hai ke users (actors) system se kin tareeqon se interact karte hain, user ki nazar se. Is ke maqsad:
Use Case Diagram UML diagram hai jo dikhata hai ke users (actors) system se kaise interact karte hain.
Maqsad: 1) functional requirements pakarna; 2) dikhana ke kaun sa actor kaun sa function istemal karta hai; 3) planning aur test cases banane mein madad.

blocks.prompt:
7. Compare and contrast a Sequence Diagram with an Activity Diagram, highlighting the key differences.
Sequence Diagram aur Activity Diagram ka muqabla karein aur aham farq bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Dono UML diagrams system ka behaviour dikhate hain, magar alag cheezein.
Dono UML diagrams system ka behaviour dikhate hain.
Sequence Diagram: objects waqt ke saath aik doosre ko kaun se messages bhejte hain (lifelines aur arrows).
Activity Diagram: kisi process ke steps ka flow, decisions aur loops samet (start node, action boxes, decision diamond).
Aham farq: sequence = kaun kis ko kab message bhejta hai; activity = kaun se steps kis tarteeb mein hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Describe the Factory Pattern and explain how it differs from directly creating objects, with an example.
Factory Pattern bayan karein aur misal ke saath bataein ke yeh objects ko seedha banane se kaise mukhtalif hai.
blocks.explanation:
Factory Pattern ek design pattern hai jis mein ek "factory" hamare liye objects banati hai. Workshop ki tarah: hum batate hain ke kya chahiye aur factory tayyar product de deti hai; hamein yeh jaanna zaroori nahi ke woh kaise bana.
Factory Pattern: design pattern jis mein ek factory hamare liye objects banati hai; hum sirf batate hain ke kis qisam ka chahiye.
Seedha banana: program khud exact class ka naam leta hai (Car()), is liye banane ka code har jagah bikhar jata hai.
Factory se: program vehicle_factory("bike") kehta hai aur factory Bike() bana kar deti hai; code ek jagah rehta hai, nayi qisam add karna aasan.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Dukaan par kehte hain "ek bike chahiye"; bike khud nahi jorte, dukaan (factory) andar se nikaal kar de deti hai. vehicle_factory("bike") bhi yahi karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Design a flowchart for a user registration process in a software application. Outline its key steps.
Software application mein user registration ke process ka flowchart banayein. Is ke aham steps likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Flowchart standard symbols se process ke steps dikhata hai: oval = Start/End, parallelogram = input/output, rectangle = process (kaam), diamond = decision (faisla), arrows = flow.
Flowchart (oopar se neeche):
1. (Oval) Start
2. (Parallelogram) Registration form dikhao
3. (Parallelogram) User naam, email aur password enter kare
4. (Diamond) Kya sab fields bhari hui aur sahi hain (email ka sahi format, mazboot password)?
   - Nahi: "Invalid input" message dikhao, wapas step 3
   - Haan: step 5
5. (Diamond) Kya yeh email pehle se registered hai?
   - Haan: "Account already exists" dikhao, wapas step 3
   - Nahi: step 6
6. (Rectangle) Naye user ka data database mein save karo (password encrypted)
7. (Rectangle) User ko confirmation email / notification bhejo
8. (Parallelogram) "Registration successful" dikhao
9. (Oval) End
Aham steps: input lena, input check (validate) karna, purana account check karna, data mehfooz save karna, user ko tasdeeq dena. Dono diamonds ki wajah se flow form par wapas jata hai jab tak sahi data na aaye.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Flowchart ko aise samjhein jaise kisi website par sign-up karte hain: form bharo, agar kuch ghalat ho to wohi form dobara aata hai (loop), agar email pehle se hai to bhi wapas, aur sab theek ho to data save ho kar "successful" ka message aata hai. Exam mein symbols sahi banana (oval, parallelogram, rectangle, diamond) aur Yes/No teer likhna zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Imagine you are managing a project to develop a simple mobile application. Describe how you would use the Agile Methodology to handle this project.
Farz karein aap ek saada mobile application banane ka project chala rahe hain. Bataein ke aap is project mein Agile Methodology kaise istemal karenge.
blocks.explanation:
Agile flexible tareeqa hai jo software ke chhote chalte hue hisse chhote cycles (iterations ya sprints) mein deta hai aur tabdeeli ke mutabiq dhal jata hai. Saada mobile app (maslan college notice-board app) ke liye main yeh karunga:
1. Requirements jama karna: users (students, teachers) se mil kar features ki list: registration/login, notices ki list, notifications, profile.
2. Features ki priority wali list bana kar 1-2 hafte ke sprints plan karna:
   - Sprint 1: registration aur login
   - Sprint 2: notices ki list aur details
   - Sprint 3: notifications aur profile
3. Har sprint Agile cycle se guzre: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, review.
4. Agile practices:
   - Continuous integration: code baar baar central repository mein merge, ghaltiyan jaldi pakri jayen.
   - Test-driven development: pehle test, phir code.
   - Pair programming: do developers ek computer par, ek likhe, doosra check kare.
5. Har sprint ke aakhir mein users ko chalti app dikhana, feedback lena, aur zaroorat ho to agle sprint ka plan badalna.
6. Stakeholders ko musalsal shamil rakhna aur team mein roz baat cheet.
Faide: zyada flexibility, features jaldi milna, customer ki satisfaction. Dhyan: final timeline kam predictable hoti hai aur stakeholders ka shamil rehna zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Agile ko aise samjhein: poori app ek dafa banane ke bajaye har 1-2 hafte mein ek chhota chalta hua hissa bana kar users ko dikhao, un ki raye lo, aur agla hissa us raye ke mutabiq banao. Is tarah ghalti jaldi pakri jaati hai aur app users ki pasand ke mutabiq banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. You are working on a project that requires extensive documentation and has very specific regulatory requirements. Discuss why the Scrum methodology might not be suitable for this project and suggest an alternative methodology.
Aap aise project par kaam kar rahe hain jis mein bohat zyada documentation chahiye aur bohat khaas regulatory (qanooni) requirements hain. Bataein ke Scrum methodology is project ke liye shayad munasib kyun nahi, aur koi doosri methodology suggest karein.
blocks.explanation:
Scrum kyun munasib nahi:
1. Scrum un projects ke liye hai jin ki requirements baar baar badalti hain; yeh chhote sprints mein kaam karta aur plan badalta rehta hai. Is project ki regulatory (qanooni) requirements fixed aur bohat khaas hain.
2. Kitab kehti hai Scrum embedded systems (sakht regulatory requirements) aur safety-critical software (medical, aerospace) ke liye munasib nahi jahan thorough documentation aur extensive validation (mukammal jaanch) zaroori hai.
3. Scrum ka zor chalte hue increments aur flexibility par hai, bhari documentation par nahi, is liye zaroori documents adhoore reh sakte hain.
4. Baar baar tabdeeli se final scope aur timeline kam predictable hoti hai, jo compliance (qanoon ki pabandi) sabit karne mein khatarnak hai.
Mutabadil (alternative): Waterfall Model.
- Linear aur sequential: Requirements, Design, Implementation, Testing, Deployment, Maintenance; har phase mukammal (aur documented) ho kar agla shuru hota hai.
- Sab requirements shuru mein jama aur likhi jaati hain, jo fixed regulatory requirements se mel khata hai.
- Saaf alag phases se progress manage, track aur audit karna aasan, aur har phase ki mukammal documentation.
- Jab requirements saaf aur fixed hon aur tabdeeli ka imkaan kam ho to yeh behtar kaam karta hai.
Is liye documentation-heavy aur regulated project ke liye Waterfall jaisa linear tareeqa behtar hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Seedhi baat: jahan qanoon aur bohat zyada kaghazi kaam (documentation) zaroori ho aur requirements badalni na hon, wahan har cheez pehle se plan kar ke qadam ba qadam chalna (Waterfall) behtar hai; Scrum tab achha hai jab requirements baar baar badlein.

blocks.prompt:
4. Consider an online banking system. Create a Use Case Diagram to show the interactions between customers, bank staff, and the system.
Online banking system lein. Use Case Diagram banayein jo customers, bank staff aur system ke darmiyan interactions dikhaye.
blocks.explanation:
Use Case Diagram: Online Banking System
Ek bara rectangle (system boundary) banayein, oopar "Online Banking System" likhein. Actors (stick figures) bahar: Customer baayein, Bank Staff daayein. Use cases ovals mein rectangle ke andar, aur har actor ko us ke use cases se lines se jorein.
Actors:
- Customer
- Bank Staff
Customer ke use cases:
- Log In
- View Account Balance
- View Transaction History / Statement
- Transfer Funds
- Pay Bills
- Update Profile / Change Password
Bank Staff ke use cases:
- Log In (ek hi oval, dono actors se jura)
- Open (Create) Customer Account
- Verify / Approve Transactions
- Handle Customer Queries
- Block or Close Account
- Generate Reports
Interaction: customer log in kar ke banking kaam karta hai; system balance dikhata, transfers aur payments record karta hai; bank staff isi system se accounts sambhalta, transactions approve karta aur customer ke sawalon ka jawab deta hai.
("Transfer Funds" aur "Pay Bills" ko include arrow se "Verify User" se jorna chapter se aage ki baat hai.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Diagram banane ka tareeqa: (1) bahar stick figures = actors, (2) andar ovals = kaam (use cases), (3) bara rectangle = system ki had, (4) actor se us ke har kaam tak seedhi line. Jo kaam dono karte hain (Log In) us ka ek hi oval dono se jorein.

blocks.prompt:
5. You are developing a food delivery application. Create a Sequence Diagram to show the process of placing an order, from the customer selecting items to the delivery of the order.
Aap food delivery application bana rahe hain. Sequence Diagram banayein jo order dene ka process dikhaye: customer ke items chunne se le kar order ki delivery tak.
blocks.explanation:
Sequence Diagram: Food order dena
Paanch lifelines banayein (oopar box, neeche khari dashed line): Customer, Food App, Restaurant, Payment Gateway, Delivery Rider. Messages ko oopar se neeche waqt ki tarteeb mein seedhe teer (arrows) se dikhayein:
1. Customer se Food App: browseMenu()
2. Food App se Customer: menu aur qeematein
3. Customer se Food App: selectItems() / addToCart()
4. Customer se Food App: placeOrder()
5. Food App se Payment Gateway: processPayment(amount)
6. Payment Gateway se Food App: paymentConfirmed
7. Food App se Restaurant: sendOrder(order)
8. Restaurant se Food App: orderAccepted (tayyari ka waqt)
9. Food App se Customer: order confirmation
10. Food App se Delivery Rider: assignDelivery(order)
11. Restaurant se Delivery Rider: khana hawale (order ready)
12. Delivery Rider se Food App: updateStatus("Picked up")
13. Food App se Customer: live tracking / "Out for delivery"
14. Delivery Rider se Customer: deliverOrder()
15. Customer se Food App: confirmDelivery() / rating
Diagram dikhata hai ke items chunne se delivery tak kaun sa object kis ko kaun sa message kis tarteeb mein bhejta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sequence diagram mein waqt oopar se neeche chalta hai. Har object ki apni khari dashed line (lifeline) hoti hai aur message ek line se doosri line tak teer hota hai. Jo message pehle hota hai woh oopar, jo baad mein woh neeche.

blocks.prompt:
6. Discuss the importance of software development tools in the software development process.
Software development process mein software development tools ki ahmiyat par baat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Software development tools woh programs hain jo software banane ke har marhale mein madad karte hain: code likhna, edit karna, translate karna, test, debug aur manage karna.
Ahmiyat:
1. Code jaldi aur aasani se likha jata hai (editors, IDEs).
2. Code machine language mein badalta hai taake chal sake (compilers, interpreters).
3. Ghaltiyan jaldi milti aur theek hoti hain (debuggers), software bharosemand banta hai.
4. IDE editor, compiler, debugger aur version control ek jagah deta hai, kaam tez hota hai.
5. Source code repositories (GitHub, Bitbucket) tabdeeliyon ki history rakhti hain aur kai developers bina conflict ek project par kaam karte hain.
6. Online aur offline platforms (Repl.it, local IDE) code likhne, chalane aur test karne ki jagah dete hain.
Kul mila kar yeh tools efficiency (kam waqt mein kaam), accuracy (durusti) aur quality barhate hain.

blocks.prompt:
6(a) Explain the role of language editors, translators, and debuggers in creating and maintaining software.
Software banane aur sambhalne mein language editors, translators aur debuggers ka kirdar samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Language editors (code editors): mukhtalif programming languages mein code likhne aur edit karne ke tools. User-friendly interface dete hain, is liye program banana aur baad mein badalna (maintain karna) aasan hota hai.
2. Translators: high-level language (jaise Python) ka code machine language (binary) mein badalte hain jo computer chala sake.
   - Interpreter: line by line translate karta hai (maslan Python interpreter).
   - Compiler: poora program ek dafa chalne se pehle translate karta hai aur efficient machine code banata hai (maslan GCC).
3. Debuggers: bugs (ghaltiyan) dhoondne aur theek karne mein madad; code step by step chalana, variables dekhna aur execution par nazar rakhna, taake pata chale ghalti kahan hai.
Software banate waqt editor se code likha jata hai, translator se chalaya jata hai aur debugger se ghaltiyan nikaali jaati hain; maintain karte waqt bhi yahi tools code update karne aur naye bugs theek karne mein kaam aate hain.

blocks.prompt:
6(b) Provide examples of each tool and describe how they contribute to the efficiency and accuracy of software development.
Har tool ki misalein dein aur bataein ke yeh software development ko efficient aur accurate (sahi) kaise banate hain.
blocks.explanation:
Language editors:
- Notepad++ (saada magar taqatwar), Sublime Text (tez aur aasan), VS Code (mashhoor, bohat extensions).
- Faida: aasan interface mein code jaldi likhna aur edit karna, typing ki ghaltiyan kam.
Translators:
- Interpreter: Python interpreter (line by line).
- Compilers: GCC (C/C++), Javac (Java).
- Faida: code khud-ba-khud aur durust machine code mein badalta hai; compiler code ko optimize bhi karta hai taake tez chale; dono syntax errors batate hain.
Debuggers:
- GDB (C/C++ ka GNU Debugger), Visual Studio Debugger (Visual Studio IDE ke andar).
- Faida: code step by step chala kar aur variables dekh kar bug ki asal jagah jaldi milti hai, ghalti sahi theek hoti hai aur software bharosemand banta hai.
Yeh sab (aksar PyCharm, Eclipse ya Visual Studio jaise IDE ke andar) waqt bachate aur software ki accuracy aur quality barhate hain.

items: MCQs ke jawab chapter ke text se: 1b 2b 3b 4b 5b 6c 7a 8c 9a 10b. Kitab ki answer key sawal 3, 6, 7 aur 9 mein text se mel nahi khati (har sawal ke neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" box).
Short aur long sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath diye gaye hain.
